semantics.clock: All input bytes sampled on positive clock edges; one byte per edge, no handshake
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous; at a reset edge discard partial or pending packets, return to boundary search, and clear done
semantics.initialization: Behavior before a synchronous reset edge is unspecified; output payload is unconstrained when done is zero
semantics.framing: While searching discard bytes with bit 3 zero. A byte with bit 3 one is the first byte; accept the next two bytes unconditionally
semantics.completion: If first, second, third bytes are sampled at edges n,n+1,n+2, done is high immediately after edge n+3 for one clock cycle and out_bytes equals their concatenation
semantics.overlap: Edge n+3 also searches for the next first byte; continuous messages can complete every three edges
semantics.payload: out_bytes[23:16] first byte, [15:8] second byte, [7:0] third byte; valid throughout done cycle

numeric.packing: 24-bit concatenation in arrival order, first byte most significant
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow behavior required

verification.oracle: Independent byte-count parser with pending completed-message publication one edge later
verification.directed: Original waveform; boundary search; bit 3 ignored for second and third bytes; back-to-back packets; all-zero/all-one payload bytes; reset at every partial and pending stage
verification.random: Deterministic pseudorandom byte streams and resets, compare done every edge and payload only when done
verification.sampling: Drive on falling edge and compare after positive edge NBA updates
verification.tools: Icarus -g2012 with explicit dev_tb top and finite compile and simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities.topic: Meaning of cycle immediately after third byte
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Original waveform explicitly samples third byte 09 at 35ns and asserts done at 45ns; use a one-edge delayed completion
